name: gizza-ai/sqlite-db-inspector
summary: Inspect SQLite tables, columns, indexes, foreign keys, views, and row counts

tool.description: Inspect an uploaded SQLite .db/.sqlite file without running user SQL. Provide the database by public http/https url or uploaded attachment ref. The tool reads the on-disk schema catalog to list tables, columns, explicit and auto-created indexes, foreign keys, views, triggers, and row counts for normal rowid tables; WITHOUT ROWID row counts are reported as unavailable rather than guessed. Choose markdown or json output, and optionally include sqlite_* internal objects.

format.description: Output format: markdown for a readable schema report (default) or json for structured table/index/view metadata.

include_internal.description: Include SQLite internal sqlite_* objects such as autoindexes. Default false; user tables still mention their auto-created indexes when relevant.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
